owner_calls.question: Loki S2 aliases stage says "God of Stories". The phrase appears in Marvel marketing and wiki prose, but I could not find it said on screen (the Wikipedia season article never uses it; the Fandom infobox cites a separate non-episode ref for it). Owner rule: only what is on screen counts. Keep it, or revert this stage to an on-screen name?
options: Change to "God of Mischief" (drop the new alias)
Change to a description, e.g. "God of Mischief. Keeper of the timelines"
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom Loki/New York Time Heist infobox lists "God of Stories" with ref GodOfStories (not the LK206 episode ref); Loki season 2 Wikipedia article has no occurrence of the phrase. The finale line on screen is "I know what kind of god I need to be. For you, for all of us."
